A horizontal screw is designed to convey molding sand of a bulk weight Y = 1.8 13   
ton/m³; required capacity, Q = 50 ton/hr; Conveying run length, L = 25 m. Calculate   
the main parameters: µ, D, N, Mg, S, q and P of the conveyor with usual meaning.   
Assume any data if required.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2023
